superseded_machine_claim: O(k^2) joint evaluations; joint mask and joint conditional entropy per non-primary pair with joint n>=50
canonical_correction: NOT all-pairs O(k^2). One scan scores every available indicator k (k<=12) and selects ONE primary by max(MI, CramersV, n); a second loop evaluates each remaining candidate only against that primary. Upper bound is k-1 candidate-vs-primary joint evaluations (<=11 at k=12), subject to support/gain gates. Per-question symbolic work is O(k*R + (k-1)*R_joint), not O(k^2). The cost inside each entropy/groupby remains unbounded here.
